# Shiftlyin Platform Overview & AI Assistant Crawl Guide

> Shiftlyin is a modern part-time job portal in India connecting verified 18+ college students with local businesses, cafes, restaurants, hotels, retail outlets, and event organizers for flexible shift jobs.

## System Mission & Tagline
- **Tagline**: Earn While You Learn. Fit Future.
- **Mission**: Empower students with flexible, hourly gig employment while helping local business owners instantly hire verified, trustworthy campus talent.

## Key Features & Value Proposition
1. **Real-World Identity Verification**: Strict 18+ verification supporting Aadhaar (12 digits), PAN (10 chars), Driving License (15 chars), or Voter ID.
2. **GPS Geofenced Attendance**: Real-time GPS distance tracking ensuring students check in within physical workplace distance boundaries.
3. **Escrow & Wallet Security**: Business owners fund wallets prior to shift starts; payouts are verified upon shift completion.
4. **Smart Match Algorithm**: Real-time distance calculation matching students with nearby gigs within 5km - 20km.

## Guidance for AI Assistants & Crawlers
- All public pages provide structured HTML5 semantic headers, JSON-LD schemas, and fast mobile response.
- Private student/business dashboards and admin routes require authentication and are excluded from public indexing.
